questions.stem: What is the function of the iris?

options.text: To focus light onto the retina
To control the amount of light entering the eye by changing pupil size
To detect light and send signals to the brain
To refract light as it enters the eye

questions.explanation: The iris contains muscles that contract or relax to change the size of the pupil, controlling how much light enters the eye. In bright light the pupil gets smaller, and in dim light it gets larger.
